'''You'tan''' {{Lang|zh=忧昙}} is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] in [[Huanglong]]. Being [[Baizhi]]'s loyal companion and a manifestation of her [[Forte]], You'tan assists Baizhi in [[Baizhi/Combat|combat]] and is the source of her healing abilities.
